info.name: trem.API
info.description:
trem.API — https://api.didilv93.com

1. Import this collection and one environment from postman/environments.
2. In the environment, fill username and password (and apiKey, optionally).
3. Run Auth › POST /auth/login. With TOTP on, it stores mfaToken: put the code in
   POST /auth/mfa/verify. The access and refresh tokens are stored as collection variables.
4. Every request sends Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}. When apiKey is set, the tool
   routes also send X-API-Key, which the API prefers over the login.
5. The access token lasts 15 minutes: POST /auth/refresh renews it. Each refresh returns a
   new refresh token and kills the old one; the script keeps the newest.

Admin routes need a login with trem:admin proven with TOTP.

Generated by scripts/build_postman_collection.py from the OpenAPI; regenerate it after
changing routes.

request.description:
Get Jwks

Public keys that sign the access tokens, for other applications to verify them locally.

Enroll Mfa

Starts a TOTP enrolment: scan the URI, then confirm with a code.

Regenerate Recovery Codes

New set of recovery codes; the old ones stop working.

Disable Mfa

Turns TOTP off and ends every session of the account.

Me

Who is logged in; works before the first password change, to tell the page to ask for it.

Create Key

The full key is in this response only; the database keeps its hash.

Approve User

Activates the account with exactly these permissions.

Suspend User

Blocks the account, ends its sessions and stops its API keys.

Set Permissions

Replaces the whole set. Sessions end so the next tokens carry the new set.

Delete Application

Removes the application with its permissions, grants and sessions.

Create Client

Cria um cliente e devolve a chave em claro — só desta vez.

Revoke Client

Revoga a chave. É irreversível — para religar, crie outro cliente.

Catalog

The services this account may open: enabled, with an address, and granted hub:<slug>.
Logo Public, for : a logo reveals nothing the catalog's front page would not.

Create Service

Creates the service and its permission hub:<slug>.

Delete Service

Removes the service, its permission and every grant of it.

formdata.description: PNG, WebP ou SVG, até 256 KB

request.description:
Grant Service

Lets the account see the service. Its sessions go on: the catalog is read live.

Compress Image Endpoint

Comprime uma imagem.

- **response_type**: 
  - `file` (padrão): Retorna o arquivo comprimido para download
  - `json`: Retorna JSON com métricas e arquivo em base64 (ideal para Swagger)

Compress Image Info Endpoint

Retorna métricas de compressão em JSON.

- **include_file**: Se True, inclui o arquivo comprimido em base64 na resposta

Movie Cut

Recorta um vídeo entre os tempos definidos.

Transcribe File

Uploads the whole file in one request and starts the transcription.
Above 100 MB, use the upload in parts.

Create Upload

Opens an upload in parts; each part goes in PUT .../parts/{index}.

Upload Part

Receives one part as the raw request body (application/octet-stream).

Complete Upload

Closes the upload and starts the transcription.

Abort Upload

Cancels the upload and deletes the parts received.

Get Job

Job state: queued, running, done (with `result`) or failed (with `error`).

Audio Cut

Recorta um áudio entre os tempos definidos.

Transcribe File

Uploads the whole file in one request and starts the transcription.
Above 100 MB, use the upload in parts.

Create Upload

Opens an upload in parts; each part goes in PUT .../parts/{index}.

Upload Part

Receives one part as the raw request body (application/octet-stream).

Complete Upload

Closes the upload and starts the transcription.

Abort Upload

Cancels the upload and deletes the parts received.

Get Job

Job state: queued, running, done (with `result`) or failed (with `error`).

Chat Completions

OpenAI-compatible chat completion, without streaming. `model` is ignored
and `max_tokens` is capped by the server.

Submit Job

Same body as /v1/chat/completions, answered at once with a `job_id` to poll.
A sleeping model is woken inside the job instead of answering 503.

Get Job

Job state: queued, running, done (with `result`) or failed (with `error`).

Create Job

Job config: name, jobs, posts, analysis, schedule, notify_to (see the README).

Update Job

Top-level sections in the body replace the current ones whole.

Upload Cv

The CV as a .docx file.

Run Job

Queues a collection ahead of the schedule.

Session State

LinkedIn session of the caller: none, valid or expired.

Start Login

Opens a remote browser on the LinkedIn login; open `url` in a new tab to use it.

Login State

starting, waiting, connected, failed, expired or cancelled.

Send Feedback

Enviar feedback, sugestão ou reporte de bug.

- **type**: Tipo do feedback (suggestion, bug, other)
- **message**: Mensagem do feedback (max 5000 caracteres)
- **email**: Email para contato (opcional)
